<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="oi0pJOkg6ZQytC1KvxOX"> <mxGraphModel dx="1800" dy="1893" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart LR
 UI[\"Streamlit frontend<br/>Enter or upload notes · Browse reports<br/>Review, edit, approve, and download\"]
 Docs[\"Swagger UI and OpenAPI<br/>GET /docs · GET /openapi.json\"]

 subgraph API[\"FastAPI backend\"]
 Router[\"Routing and Pydantic validation\"]

 subgraph Routes[\"API endpoints\"]
 Health[\"GET /health<br/>Check API liveness\"]
 Generate[\"POST /reports/generate<br/>Generate and save a DAP draft\"]
 Retrieve[\"GET /reports/{report_id}<br/>Return source notes and report\"]
 List[\"GET /reports<br/>List and filter saved reports\"]
 Upload[\"POST /notes/extract<br/>Extract text for user review\"]
 Edit[\"PATCH /reports/{report_id}<br/>Save reviewer edits\"]
 Approve[\"POST /reports/{report_id}/approve<br/>Record explicit approval\"]
 Export[\"GET /reports/{report_id}/pdf<br/>Download an approved report\"]
 end

 subgraph Services[\"Backend components\"]
 LLM[\"Ollama client<br/>Generate Data, Assessment, and Plan\"]
 Storage[\"SQLite storage layer\"]
 Extractor[\"File text extraction\"]
 Review[\"Review and approval rules\"]
 PDF[\"PDF renderer\"]
 end

 Router --> Health & Generate & Retrieve
 Router -.-> List & Upload & Edit & Approve & Export

 Generate <-->|\"Send notes and receive DAP sections\"| LLM
 Generate -->|\"Save source notes and draft\"| Storage
 Retrieve -->|\"Load by report ID\"| Storage
 List -.->|\"Filter by student ID, school, grade,<br/>date of service, or status\"| Storage
 Upload -.-> Extractor
 Edit -.-> Review
 Approve -.-> Review
 Review -.->|\"Save edits and approval\"| Storage
 Export -.->|\"Load report and check approval\"| Storage
 Export -.->|\"Render approved content\"| PDF
 end

 Ollama[\"Local Ollama server\"]
 DB[(\"Local SQLite<br/>data/dap.db\")]
 Template[\"School DAP PDF template\"]

 UI -.->|\"HTTP requests\"| Router
 Docs --> Router
 LLM <-->|\"POST /api/chat\"| Ollama
 Storage <--> DB
 Template -.-> PDF

 classDef planned fill:#fff3d6,stroke:#946200,color:#332200
 class UI,List,Upload,Edit,Approve,Export,Extractor,Review,PDF,Template planned",
